text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own the VISUAL PRESENTATION of the interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment

name: Facet
text:
Decision: Make the interface’s key actions glow softly when idle, then pulse brighter when hovered or clicked.

Why: This balances visibility and calm. The glow keeps the interface alive without shouting, while the pulse rewards interaction—making the UI feel responsive and enjoyable. Trade-off: it adds a little visual noise, but the clarity of highlighting actions outweighs that. Done.
